//: Merged (not overwritten) into .claude/settings.json by the installer (pack.yaml: merge: true). Adds the Azure DevOps twins of the core file's GitHub entries: read-only az repos/pipelines queries on the allow-list (az repos pr show/list are the ADO analogue of gh pr view/list — az has no 'pr view'; runs list/show mirror gh run list/view), mutating az calls and the branch-policy script behind ask (the analogue of gh api and apply-branch-protection.sh), and the pipeline definitions as a gated path with the same tamper protection ./.github/** has. 'az repos policy' is grouped whole under ask even though 'policy list' is a read: ask rules take precedence over allow in Claude Code, so a list carve-out would be shadowed anyway — and doctor.py calls az via subprocess, invisible to these rules, so it stays headless either way. The core's gh entries survive the merge — harmless on an ADO repo, where nothing invokes gh.
